entry: run(fullfile(pwd,'s1_telescope.m'))   % then s2_instrument ... s7_simulate, in order
run_ref: Part I is this template's run: Sections 1 to 6 follow its seven stages, each run unchanged in one thread directory, every listing and number generated (Section 1 prints stage 1's design report; Section 7 steps off the thread for the budget). This page adds the one stage-1 figure Part I did not print.
caption: Stage 1's field-curvature map (`s1_fpmap.png`, from the Section 1 run): the sag of each field point's best focus from the fitted, tilted focal plane over the ±0.25′ map, in micrometres.
number: Stage 1 delivers an effective focal length of %pin:ch01_efl_m% (%pin:ch01_fno%), λ/D %pin:ch01_lamD_mas%, with the fold cleared at a %pin:ch01_bias_arcmin% field bias and a primary hole %pin:ch01_hole_r_m% in radius (Section 1). The thread's later numbers are Sections 2 to 6's; its committed outputs are stale against these live runs, finding (bbb).
prompt: Using templates/80_end_to_end/e2e, change e2e_params for a 6 m f/16 version of the telescope and rerun stages 1 and 2, telling me the delivered f-number, the field ladder and whether the fold still clears.
